Container.Name: velociraptor
Container.Overview:
Velociraptor DFIR server running in Docker (xboarder56 fork), adapted for Unraid. Multi-arch image: linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
Mapped services: - Frontend / client ingress: 8000/tcp - API / gRPC gateway: 8001/tcp - Web GUI (HTTPS): 8889/tcp - Prometheus metrics: 8003/tcp
Persistent path: - /mnt/user/appdata/velociraptor -> /velociraptor (config, keys, artifacts, repacked client bundles — all stored here)
First run: The container auto-generates server.config.yaml and client.config.yaml and repacks Linux (.deb/.rpm amd64+arm64), macOS (amd64+arm64) and Windows (.exe/.msi) clients into /velociraptor/client_bundles/. A small build banner (version, arch, base image, git commit, build date) is printed to the log on every start.
Login: Open https://[UNRAID-IP]:8889, accept the self-signed TLS certificate and log in with the credentials set via VELOX_DEFAULT_USER / VELOX_DEFAULT_PASSWORD. Change them immediately after first login!
Security: - TLS is self-signed by default; rotate keys/certificates from the Velociraptor GUI. - Keep API port 8001 and metrics port 8003 restricted to trusted networks only. - VELOX_DEFAULT_USER/PASSWORD are only used for the initial bootstrap user.
Troubleshooting: docker logs -f velociraptor docker exec -it velociraptor sh
Source: https://github.com/Xboarder56/velociraptor-docker Fork of: https://github.com/weslambert/velociraptor-docker (Wes Lambert)
Container.Changes: Update template to xboarder56/velociraptor fork: new image/repo URLs, add Prometheus port 8003, replace manual server.config.yaml requirement with runtime env-var configuration (VELOX_DEFAULT_USER/PASSWORD, VELOX_FRONTEND_*, VELOX_GUI_*, VELOX_API_PORT, VELOX_MONITORING_PORT, VELOX_START_SERVER_VERBOSE), remove /var/logs volume (logs now in /velociraptor), update Overview for auto-generated config and multi-arch client repacks, add Security category.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, e.g. Etc/UTC or America/New_York.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Bootstrap admin username for the Velociraptor GUI. Change after first login.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Bootstrap admin password. Change immediately after first login!

Config.Name: Admin Role
Config.Description: Role assigned to the bootstrap user (e.g. administrator, analyst, investigator).

Config.Name: Frontend Hostname
Config.Description: Public hostname clients use to reach the server. Set to your Unraid IP or FQDN.

Config.Name: Frontend Port
Config.Description: Public-facing port clients use to reach the server (built into client URL).

Config.Name: Frontend Scheme
Config.Description: Scheme for client URL: https (recommended) or http.

Config.Name: Frontend Server URL (override)
Config.Description: Full client URL override, e.g. https://ingest.example.com:8000/ — overrides Hostname/Port/Scheme if set.

Config.Name: GUI Hostname
Config.Description: Public hostname for the admin GUI. Defaults to Frontend Hostname if not set.

Config.Name: GUI Port
Config.Description: Public-facing port for the admin GUI.

Config.Name: GUI Scheme
Config.Description: Scheme for GUI URL: https or http.

Config.Name: GUI URL (override)
Config.Description: Full GUI URL override, e.g. https://admin.example.com:8889/app/index.html — overrides GUI Hostname/Port/Scheme if set.

Config.Name: API / gRPC Port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal gRPC API port. Only change if you have a port conflict.

Config.Name: Prometheus Metrics Port (internal)
Config.Description: Internal Prometheus metrics port. Only change if you have a port conflict.

Config.Name: Verbose Server Logs
Config.Description: Set to true to enable verbose (-v) server logs (DEBUG level). Leave false for INFO only.

Config.Name: Frontend / Client Ingress
Config.Description: Velociraptor frontend/client ingress port. Clients connect here.

Config.Name: API / gRPC Gateway
Config.Description: Velociraptor API/gRPC gateway port. Restrict to trusted networks only.

Config.Name: Web GUI (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Velociraptor Web GUI. Open https://[IP]:8889 in your browser.

Config.Name: Prometheus Metrics
Config.Description: Prometheus metrics endpoint. Restrict to monitoring network if not needed publicly.

Config.Name: Velociraptor Data
Config.Description: Persistent data directory: config, keys, artifacts and repacked client bundles are all stored here.
